'''GXR-5 Sabotage Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it was aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' during the [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|attack]] by the [[Gage-class transport]] ''[[Black Talon]]''. GXR-5 boarded the vessel, but was destroyed by the Imperials aboard.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
GXR-5 Sabotage Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Black Talon" flashpoint only if players choose the ''Dark Side'' option during their conversation with Captain [[Revinal Orzik|Orzik]], killing him.
